content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler squash, Stage 1 is a smooth pumpkin puree designed for infants aged 6–12 months. The puree is made from selected pumpkin varieties, without added sugar, salt or preservatives. It is rich in vitamins A and C as well as dietary fiber, making it an ideal first vegetable food.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pumpkin contains more than 20 different carotenoids, of which beta‑carotene is converted to vitamin A in the body.
The unsweetened puree retains the natural mild sweetness of pumpkin that most babies enjoy.
Pumpkin is one of the first vegetables recommended by pediatricians for introduction to a baby’s diet.
Its soft texture is easy to digest and requires no additional mashing.
Pumpkin is cultivated in many climate zones, ensuring consistent quality year‑round.

items.title: Rich in vitamin A
items.content: Vitamin A supports vision, cell growth, and the immune system, which is crucial during early development.

items.title: Contains vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C boosts the body’s defenses and aids iron absorption from plant foods.

items.title: Fiber for digestion
items.content: Dietary fiber helps regulate bowel movements and prevents constipation in infants.

items.title: Low in added sugar and salt
items.content: The absence of added sugars and salts helps develop healthy taste preferences.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Carotenoids and other phytonutrients protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Allergic reaction
items.content: Allergy to pumpkin is rare, but monitor the baby closely when first introduced.

items.title: Over‑feeding
items.content: Too much puree can upset the balance of nutrients; offer small portions.

items.title: Temperature control
items.content: Serve the puree warm, not hot, to avoid burns.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the puree on its own or blend it with other vegetable or fruit purees. Warm gently to a comfortable temperature, testing on the wrist before feeding.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package refrigerated for up to 5 days. Once opened, transfer to an airtight container and store in the fridge. For longer storage, freeze in portion‑size containers for up to 3 months.
